purpose: Teach: 宿舎/華麗/赤外線/右脳/速記/接着/解像度/諸島

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、学生時代に寮の宿舎にお住まいだったって、メイちゃん
lines.en: This customer told me he lived in a dorm during his student days, Aoi.
lines.style: Soft observation, genuine interest. Tone is warmth-tinged wondering. Unhurried pace. Trailing particle carries affection without pushiness.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、華麗な舞台衣装の写真を見せて下さったよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: He showed me photos of these beautiful stage costumes he wore, Mei.
lines.style: Reminiscent, almost admiring. Quiet appreciation in the voice. Slight lift on the memory. Easy, conversational pace without urgency.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、赤外線リモコンの修理が趣味だって、メイちゃん
lines.en: Apparently fixing infrared remote controls is his hobby, Aoi.
lines.style: Gentle amusement underneath. Slight wonderment — charmed by the specificity of it. Soft, unhurried delivery. Affectionate name-tag at the end.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、右脳トレーニング法を研究されてるって、メイちゃん
lines.en: He's been researching right-brain training methods, Mei.
lines.style: Engaged, thoughtful tone. Slight emphasis on the dedication implied. Warm but measured. The cadence of someone sharing something unexpected about someone interesting.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、速記者として活躍されてたんだって、メイちゃん
lines.en: He was active as a stenographer, you know — that takes real skill, Aoi.
lines.style: Quiet respect woven through. Gentle wonder at the breadth of his life. Unhurried, almost reverent pace. Soft settling on the final name.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お店のポスター、接着が剥がれてるね、メイちゃん
lines.en: The poster's starting to peel at the edges, isn't it.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact observation, not complaint. Light, practical tone. Brief eye-contact glance toward the poster. No particular weight — just noticing something that needs tending.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、高解像度のカメラがご趣味だって、メイちゃん
lines.en: He's really into high-resolution cameras, apparently — quite the enthusiast.
lines.style: Gentle admiration. Soft emphasis on the detail-oriented passion. Unhurried, warm pacing. Trailing off slightly, inviting Aoi to add her own observation.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、伊豆諸島の旅がご趣味だって、メイちゃん
lines.en: He loves traveling to the Izu Islands, Mei.
lines.style: Wistful warmth. Appreciative tone, as if the image of island journeys itself brings quiet joy. Slower pace, slightly dreamy. Soft, close ending — intimate between the two.
